# Lab 10 — Missing Data & Model Building 🐈

Render to Word and submit both files.

The owners of 240 cats reported each cat's age, whether it's indoor
only, how much it naps, how many cardboard boxes are in the home, and
how many hours a day it spends on a lap. They also scored the cat on
the Cat Contentment Index (0 to 40). The codebook is on the lab page.

Answer under each **Your Answer:** line, in complete sentences. A number
with no sentence attached earns no credit.
